items: 2–3 medium fresh tomatoes (about 1–1 1/2 lb), stems removed
2 serrano peppers or 1 jalapeño, stems/ribs/seeds removed (to taste)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste

steps: Roughly chop the tomatoes, chiles, and onion. (If desired, set aside some chile seeds to increase heat later.)
Add all ingredients to a food processor and pulse a few times until finely diced (do not purée). Alternatively, finely dice everything by hand.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt/pepper. If too hot, add more chopped tomato. If not hot enough, add a few reserved seeds or a bit more cumin.
Optional: let sit for 1 hour (room temp or chilled) for flavors to combine.
Serve with chips, tacos, burritos, tostadas, or quesadillas. Refrigerate leftovers up to 5 days.
